summary: Mr. Sutton explores the leadership of the first pair of Zugot, Yose ben Yoezer Ish Tzeredah and Yose ben Yochanan Ish Yerushalayim. He compares their ability to work together despite their differences to the conflict between Yeravam ben Nevat and Rechavam ben Shlomo. By visiting the site of Tzeredah, he examines how the physical location of these leaders influenced their capacity for compromise and cooperation.
questions: Who were the first pair of Zugot mentioned in Pirkei Avot?
How does the history of Yeravam and Rechavam relate to the Zugot?
What does the location of Tzeredah reveal about the leadership of Yose ben Yoezer?
How can the model of the Zugot help us cooperate with others today?
